grid.layout_notes: CMS: 6 reels × 4 rows with 6 locked boxes + enhancer row on top. Page rowsReels 2-3-4-4-3-2 reflects locked/visible profile before unlocks.

win_system.notes: winType Ways on page; exact ways count not printed.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Avalanches; new symbols enter with Global Multiplier; Global Mult starts 1×, +1 after win and via specials.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: Locked boxes open via xBomb adjacent, xSplit row, Hunter, or bonus triggers.

other.name: Enhancer row
other.how_it_works: Top specials (xSplit, xWays, Toxic xWays, Infectious xWays, Rat, Rat King, Hunter) activate when they fall into the reel area during avalanches.

other.name: Global Multiplier
other.how_it_works: Starts 1×; +1 after a win; also rises from xBomb, Rats, Rat King, Hunter, Redemption Girl win contribution.

wilds.name: xWild
wilds.behavior: Converts entire reel to Wilds keeping mults; skips Bonus/Reckoning Girl/Rat/Rat King.

wilds.name: Redemption Girl
wilds.behavior: Wild that sums mults from same reel (not Rat mults); if in win, adds its mult to Global for next collapse.

multipliers.name: Global / symbol multipliers
multipliers.behavior: Global starts 1×; symbols enter at Global; specials add. Hunter +50× to self, all symbols, and Global.

specials.name: xBomb
specials.behavior: Explodes adjacents except Wild/Reckoning Girl/Bonus; +1 win mult next collapse; opens adjacent locked boxes.

specials.name: xSplit
specials.behavior: Splits row symbols doubling their mult; opens locked boxes in row; then becomes regular.

specials.name: xWays / Toxic xWays / Infectious xWays
specials.behavior: Reveal paying symbol at Global then +2–4× (xWays), +2× to all instances (Toxic), or double all instances (Infectious — Vengeance/Redemption only).

specials.name: Hunter
specials.behavior: Enhancer/locked boxes only; +50× to self, all reel symbols, and Global (skips Redemption Girl/Rat/Rat King/Bonus).

specials.name: Rat / Rat King
specials.behavior: 4+ Rats/Rat Kings remove and add their mults to Global (Rat 1–5×; Rat King 15/20/25×). Split doubles count not mult.

base_game_loop.summary: Ways avalanches on 6×4 with locked boxes + enhancer row. Global Mult climbs; xBomb/xSplit/xWays/Toxic/xWild/Redemption Girl/Hunter/Rats. 3/4/5 Bonus → Reckoning 7 / Vengeance 10 / Redemption (all boxes open). Boosters 1.5×/7.5×/30×/1,869×; optional xTra Extra Spin. Cap 34,000×.

phases.name: Configure boosters
phases.what_happens: Optional Bonus Booster 1.5×, Gritty 7.5× (Global/symbols 5×), Grittier 30× (20×), Grittiest 1,869× (500×).
phases.state_changes: Stake charged; Global may be preset

phases.name: Avalanche loop
phases.what_happens: Pay ways; tumble; enhancer specials fall in; open boxes; raise Global.

phases.name: Bonus / xTra check
phases.what_happens: 3/4/5 Bonus → bonus modes; else optional Extra Spin if cost ≤ prior win.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Ways after each avalanche with symbol and Global multipliers.
base_game_loop.notes: CMS; Redemption Spins count not printed (only trigger + all boxes open).

modes.name: Reckoning Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Global Mult persists; unlocked boxes stay open for the round.

modes.name: Vengeance Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Reckoning features; locked boxes on reels 5–6 open at trigger; Infectious xWays in enhancer row.

phases.name: Enter Vengeance
phases.what_happens: 10 spins; open reels 5–6 boxes; Infectious xWays available.

modes.effects: 10 FS; open last two reels' boxes; Infectious xWays.

modes.name: Redemption Spins
modes.spins_awarded: Not printed on CMS (Vengeance features + all locked boxes open).
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: All locked boxes opened at trigger; Infectious xWays; persistent Global.

phases.name: Enter Redemption
phases.what_happens: All boxes open; Vengeance feature set.

modes.effects: Top bonus; all boxes open; Infectious xWays.

bonus_free_spins.notes: Redemption spin count not stated on CMS.

features.name: xBomb
features.effects: Explode adjacents; +1 next collapse; open adjacent boxes.

features.name: xSplit / xWays / Toxic / Infectious
features.effects: Row split / reveal paying with mult boosts.

features.name: Gritty Spins
features.effects: Global + symbols at 5× (except Redemption Girl/Rat/Rat King/Bonus).

features.name: xTra Extra Spin
features.trigger: After round if cost ≤ prior win
features.effects: Keep Global + opened boxes for one more spin.

options.name: xTra Extra Spin
options.effects: Post-round extra spin if cost ≤ prior win.

ante_bet.notes: Bonus Booster 1.5× is light per-spin guarantee.
